## Why regmonkey-shellutils?

Daily Linux workflows involve a lot of repetitive tasks — checking memory, grepping history, converting videos, pinging hosts. `regmonkey-shellutils` wraps these into clean, well-documented scripts that follow consistent conventions:

- **Predictable options** — long and short flags (`--help` / `-h`), consistent error messages
- **Composable** — designed for pipelines; most scripts read stdin or write stdout
- **Zero dependencies** by default — use standard POSIX/GNU tools

## Quick Install

```bash
# Clone into ~/.local/share
git clone https://github.com/RyoNakagami/regmonkey-shellutils.git \
  ~/.local/share/regmonkey-shellutils

# Add all bin/* subdirectories to PATH in ~/.zshrc
REGMONKEY_SHELLUTILS_PATH="$HOME/.local/share/regmonkey-shellutils"
_shellutils_root="${REGMONKEY_SHELLUTILS_PATH}/bin"
if [[ -d "${_shellutils_root}" ]]; then
  for _d in "${_shellutils_root}"/*/; do
    [[ -d "${_d}" ]] && export PATH="${_d%/}:$PATH"
  done
fi
unset _shellutils_root _d REGMONKEY_SHELLUTILS_PATH
```

See the [Installation guide](docs/installation.qmd) for more details.
